# Branches that deploy their own BrainTF instance (terraform/main_module) on push.
# One branch name per line (exact match of the ref name, e.g.
# feature/EPMCACMAWS-504-automated-deployment). Blank lines and lines starting
# with "#" are ignored.
#
# Each listed branch gets its own instance: resource names are suffixed with an ID
# derived from the branch (.github/scripts/instance-id.sh, e.g. epmcacmaws-504), it
# registers its own webhook, and it only answers comments on that branch's PR.
# Branches that carry the same ticket key derive the same ID: the instance belongs
# to the branch that deployed it first, and the others are refused.
# Tear it down with the "Destroy BrainTF" workflow (also runs on PR close/branch delete).
#
# This file is the single source of truth for BOTH:
#   - the deploy-braintf.yml workflow gate (which branches trigger a deploy), and
#   - the OIDC role trust policy (terraform/main_module/main.tf local.sub_values),
#     so a branch listed here is also allowed to assume the AWS role.
#
# NOTE: main is implicit and always deploys to PROD - do not list it here.
# After adding/removing a branch, re-apply the PROD state so the shared OIDC
# role's trust picks up the change.
# Temporarily disabled: remove the leading "# " to deploy this branch again.


feature/EPMCACMAWS-504-automated-deployment
